questions.q: What is the advice about learning the supplication for anxiety and sorrow that the Prophet SAW taught?
options: Learn and memorise it, because the Prophet SAW told us to
questions.explain: The companions asked if they should learn it and he told them to.

questions.q: To whom should we pour out our sorrow directly?
options: Allah, and there is no harm in sharing with a friend
questions.explain: Looking for a listener who can lend an ear is not wrong.

questions.q: What does shaytan do when calamity strikes us?
options: Works overtime planting despair and blame against the decree
questions.explain: Beware when sad: shaytan is most active.

questions.q: What manner of supplication is mentioned in this lecture?
questions.explain: Asking arrogantly then claiming God does not hear is not the etiquette of prayer.

questions.q: Who decides the names of Allah?
options: Allah Himself; we do not add to them
questions.explain: We name Allah only with the names He named Himself.

questions.q: What is the difference between huzn and ham?
options: Huzn is for men, ham for women
Huzn is grief over what has happened, ham is anxiety about what is to come

questions.q: What is the lesson when the Prophet SAW asked why Abu Umamah was sitting in the mosque?
options: Pray but also rise up; do not surrender without effort

questions.q: What should we do when we see someone who seems unlike themselves?
options: Be sensitive and ask, like the Prophet SAW
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW noticed and asked when he saw a companion seeming off.

questions.q: Why does social media make gratitude harder?
options: Because we constantly see those who have more
questions.explain: Look at those with less in worldly matters.

questions.q: Trials humble the heart and remind us we are servants.
questions.explain: True. When we felt powerful and then everything is gone, we are reminded.

questions.q: The Quran is a cure, but it needs a prayer to touch the heart.
questions.explain: True. Reading without this prayer may not reach the heart.
